name: 20/20 Custom Molded Plastics
old_description: Our strength is in developing, improving, and initiating new and existing applications in both high and low pressure injection molding for cost reduction.
about:
20/20 Custom Molded Plastics operates from its headquarters in Bluffton, Indiana, with additional facilities in Holiday City, Ohio, and Covington, Georgia. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, nor are its founders named in available materials.

The company specializes in structural foam molding, structural web/gas assist, and high-pressure injection molding, running presses from 375 to 1,500 tons capable of producing single parts up to 200 pounds. A 135,000-square-foot, purpose-built facility houses custom shot-to-shot consistency controls, in-house engineering with CAD software, and secondary operations including assembly, machining, finishing, packaging, and drop shipping.

20/20 serves customers such as Yamaha, which has recognized the company with a supplier award, though specific industry sectors are not listed. The firm emphasizes part and mold design assistance, tooling management, and quality control tailored to each client.

Founded on a mission to exceed customer expectations, 20/20 differentiates itself through structural foam expertise that reduces resin use, cuts part weight by up to 15%, and leverages less expensive aluminum tooling. Custom nozzle controls and sequences ensure repeatability from prototype through long-term production.

name: 27WON Performance
old_description: FL5/DE5/FK8 Owners (And More) Rejoice! Your Upgraded 2.0T Bypass Valve Is Here.
about:
27WON Performance is based in Henderson, Nevada. The company traces its roots to founders who began customizing and racing personal cars before launching a Mazda-focused performance business in 1998. After two decades of experience, they applied that knowledge to the Honda platform, naming the new venture after the Honda RA271 — the first Japanese-built Formula 1 car to enter a race. The brand emerged from a passion for elevating Honda and Acura performance to a new level.

The company designs and manufactures a range of bolt-on performance parts for late-model Hondas and Acuras, including cold-air intakes, big-brake kits, turbocharger upgrades, coolant expansion tanks, inlet pipes, brake calipers, rotors, and bypass valves. Products are developed through engineering and validation processes that emphasize fit, function, and aesthetics. The catalog covers 10th- and 11th-generation Civic Si, Type R, Type S, and Integra models.

27WON serves automotive enthusiasts, track-day drivers, and owners seeking OEM-plus upgrades for Honda and Acura vehicles. Customer ideas drive the product roadmap; nearly every new part originates from community submissions. The company also offers installation services and build documentation through its 'Installations-Builds' section.

The brand's stated differentiator is a 'no-shortcuts' philosophy: each component is crafted to perform and look amazing, with a focus on stopping faster, accelerating harder, and carving corners. Core values — putting the team first, being a utility player, executing the right tasks well, elevating each other with candor, and loving cars and community — frame the culture. The name itself honors Honda's racing heritage, reinforcing a mission to redefine the aftermarket.

name: 3 Crowns Apparel Services
old_description: 3Crowns is small batch development and manufacturing studio - pattern making, sample development, sourcing and manufacturing all under one roof. We help brands of any size turn ideas into sellable product.
about:
3 Crowns Apparel Services operates as a vertically integrated apparel design and manufacturing facility in Brooklyn, New York. The studio was founded to make fashion a more equitable and accessible space for independent designers and emerging brands, built on pillars of craft, partnership, and ethical operations.

The company provides end-to-end development and production services under one roof: product strategy and planning, pattern making, sample development, sourcing of fabrics, trims, and hardware, and small-batch manufacturing. Master tailors on staff enable production of tailored clothing, gowns, ready-to-wear, activewear, and children's apparel. The facility handles pre-production build setup, including spec review, measurement alignment, and component specification, through to production readiness with detailed material requirements.

3 Crowns serves emerging and established apparel brands of any size, as well as independent designers seeking to turn concepts into production-ready products. Its consulting arm draws on over 18 years of fashion industry experience spanning visual merchandising, creative services, design, buying, retail development, and business management.

The studio differentiates itself through its commitment to craft and partnership, offering a full scope of services that bridge design and manufacturing. By keeping development and production in-house, it aims to reduce barriers for smaller brands and ensure ethical, transparent operations from strategy to shelf.

name: 3-V Distributing Inc
old_description: “Our quality of work and knowledge of our products are our greatest attribute.”
about:
3-V Distributing Inc. is based in Conrad, Montana. Founded in 1978 by John VanDyke, the company began as a seller, distributor, and installer of aluminum grain bodies produced by ITB Inc. VanDyke recognized a regional need for quality truck equipment and built the business around that gap. Ownership passed to his son, Jordan VanDyke, who now serves as president, keeping the operation family-run.

The company distributes and installs a range of truck and trailer equipment, including grain bodies, dump bodies, flatbeds, landscape bodies, lift axles, suspensions, bale beds, hoists, tarp systems, snow and ice equipment, and hydraulic systems. It carries product lines from manufacturers such as ITB, Henderson, Crysteel, DuraClass, Rugby, Deweze, Henke, Force America, Cirus, Buyers Products, CPI, Rol Oyl, Pintle Hitch, and SwapLoader. No facility size or headcount figures are disclosed.

3-V Distributing serves customers throughout Montana, with a focus on agricultural and commercial trucking sectors. The VanDyke family’s own farming background informs their product selection, and they emphasize hands-on familiarity with the equipment they supply.

The company cites its quality of work and product knowledge as its greatest attribute, according to President Jordan VanDyke. A reputation for quality and service has sustained a loyal customer base across the state for over 48 years.

name: 307 Meat Processing
old_description: Our shop takes great pleasure in providing our community with quality products. We provide vacuum-sealed products for optimal freshness and longevity.
about:
307 Meat Processing operates from Mills, Wyoming, tracing its roots to the mid-1960s when it began as Pat's Meat, a seasonal wild game processing service run from a garage. The family-owned business has remained under family stewardship since its founding, evolving over decades into a full-service custom butcher shop serving central Wyoming.

The shop processes both domestic livestock and wild game, offering custom cutting, vacuum-sealed packaging rated for up to two years of freezer storage, and mobile slaughter services that travel to ranches and farms. Its in-house sausage production has earned local awards, and the facility handles everything from field-dressed antelope to beef sides for area ranchers.

Customers include local ranchers who rely on the mobile slaughter unit, hunters bringing in wild game such as antelope, and households purchasing domestic beef and pork. The company emphasizes collaboration with area producers and positions itself as a community-focused butcher for the Casper region.

Founded on a passion for butcher craftsmanship, the business distinguishes itself through vacuum-sealing technology that preserves freshness, on-site slaughter capability, and a family-run operation that has served the same region for over fifty years.

name: 3D Medical Manufacturing by TECOMET
old_description: Together, with our technical expertise and focus on precision, we’ll help you create quality, innovative solutions that meet your most complex manufacturing needs.
about:
Tecomet, headquartered in West Palm Beach, Florida, operates as a contract manufacturer with a legacy spanning more than 50 years. The company combined with Orchid in a merger that brought together two organizations to expand global manufacturing capabilities.

The company provides end-to-end manufacturing services for medical device and aerospace customers, including precision CNC machining, Swiss turning, forging, in-house tool design, laser processing, and sterile cleanroom assembly. Its footprint comprises 24 manufacturing campuses across six countries, staffed by approximately 3,500 employees. Services range from product ideation and prototyping to full-scale production and packaging support.

Tecomet serves medical device companies, focusing on orthopedic applications such as shoulder, spine, trauma, hip, knee, and minimally invasive surgical instruments. The aerospace segment is also noted in its manufacturing solutions portfolio. Customers engage the firm for collaborative development programs, including the proprietary LaunchRight process for high-touch design and upfront engineering.

The company emphasizes its scalable, end-to-end capabilities, rigorous quality standards, and commitment to innovation as key differentiators. Proprietary technologies and a collaborative partnership model are positioned to solve complex manufacturing challenges and accelerate time to market.

name: 417 Motorsports
old_description: We have added custom manufactured 991.2 PSE downpipes to the website.
about:
417 Motorsports operates from Springfield, Missouri, supplying fabricated components to the racing and enthusiast markets. The company’s founding year and ownership structure have not been publicly disclosed.

The shop produces custom fabricated parts using CNC plasma cutting, and handles racecar plumbing and wiring. Its product line includes header flanges for Big Block Chevy, LSX, and LTX engines, as well as a recently added Porsche 991.2 PSE downpipe. The catalog also covers cooling systems, intercoolers, suspension components, induction parts, Mustang front-end accessories, plumbing fittings, valve covers, and fuel rails.

Customers range from professional racing teams to individual car enthusiasts building performance vehicles. The company serves the motorsports and automotive aftermarket sectors, with specific applications for Porsche, Ford Mustang, and General Motors LS/LT platforms.

417 Motorsports is an authorized Holley EFI dealer and installer, a status the company highlights as part of its service offering. It also runs an annual October campaign donating a portion of apparel sales to the Breast Cancer Foundation of the Ozarks.
